target_pattern: Build present progressive with estar + gerundio, apply common irregular gerunds correctly, and choose between progressive and simple present based on natural usage context.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Overusing progressive and forcing it onto motion verbs and habitual actions.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Progressive marks in-progress action, but Spanish often prefers simple present when context is clear.
target_pattern_formula: ar endings go to ando, er/ir endings go to iendo
irregular gerunds include diciendo, pidiendo, durmiendo, leyendo, oyendo, siguiendo
use estar tratando de + infinitive for trying to do something
prefer simple present with common motion verbs in basic conversation

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using the target pattern.
prompts_en: I am speaking with my friend.
I am talking to my sister.
I am studying Spanish right now.
They are sleeping in the living room.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Estoy hablando con mi amigo. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: Estamos comiendo tacos. -> change object to ensalada.
Base: Ella esta viendo la pelicula. -> change to ellos.
Base: Ellos estan leyendo un libro. -> change noun to plural libros.
Base: El esta oyendo un ruido. -> change verb to escuchar keeping progressive.
Base: Estoy estudiando espanol ahora mismo. -> make it negative.
Base: Estas escribiendo una carta. -> make it question form with usted.
Base: El esta bebiendo cafe. -> change object to te.
Base: Estamos limpiando la casa. -> change subject to ella.
Base: Ellos estan durmiendo en la sala. -> change location to el dormitorio.
Base: Estoy diciendo algo importante. -> change subject to nosotros.
Base: El esta pidiendo ayuda. -> change to plural subject ellos.
Base: Ella esta explicando el problema. -> change object to la solucion.
Base: Ellos estan construyendo una casa. -> change to singular subject el.
Base: Ellos estan siguiendo las instrucciones. -> change to singular yo.

prompts: I am reading now. (Estoy leyendo ahora. vs Leo ahora. both possible; progressive targets explicit in-progress.)
What are you doing? (Que haces? vs Que estas haciendo? simple present often preferred.)
He is coming now. (Viene ahora. vs Esta viniendo ahora. default preferred pattern.)
I am going to the store now. (Voy a la tienda ahora. vs Estoy yendo a la tienda ahora. default preferred pattern.)
They are sleeping in the car. (Estan durmiendo en el coche. vs Duermen en el coche. for explicit in-progress choose progressive.)
We are hearing a noise. (Estamos oyendo un ruido. vs Estamos oiendo un ruido.)
She is asking for help. (Ella esta pidiendo ayuda. vs Ella esta pediendo ayuda.)
I am saying the truth. (Estoy diciendo la verdad. vs Estoy deciendo la verdad.)
They are following the instructions. (Estan siguiendo las instrucciones. vs Estan seguiendo las instrucciones.)
We are trying to learn Spanish. (Estamos tratando de aprender espanol. vs Estamos tratando aprender espanol.)

common_errors.why_it_happens: Missing y insertion in vowel sequence verb.

common_errors.mistake: Default progressive with ir and venir
common_errors.why_it_happens: Direct transfer from English continuous usage.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Prefer voy and viene in common contexts.

common_errors.mistake: Ignoring accent in esta verb form
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use standard accent where appropriate in formal writing.

common_errors.mistake: Using progressive whenever context is present
common_errors.correct_spanish: Choose simple present when conversationally natural.
